user.title: Connect to a Vigiora server
user.description: Enter the address of your Vigiora server and an API key created in Vigiora (Settings → API keys).

data_description.api_key: A key starting with vgk_. Read-only scopes are enough for cameras, sensors and events.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave on unless the server uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Vigiora API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} no longer works (revoked or expired). Enter a new one.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host name.
error.missing_scope: The API key needs at least the cameras:read scope.
error.ssl_error: The server's TLS certificate could not be verified. Turn off certificate verification only if you trust this server.

abort.already_configured: This Vigiora server is already configured.

data_description.alerts_only: Off: every detection (person, car, …) fires the alert event.

approval_required.message: Vigiora requires a person's approval for {operation} (human in the loop is on for this API key). Home Assistant never approves on your behalf: do it in the Vigiora app, or ask an admin to turn human in the loop off for this key.

unauthenticated.message: The Vigiora API key was refused.

payment_required.message: Your Vigiora plan does not allow this ({code}): {message}

insufficient_scope.message: The Vigiora API key lacks the {scope} scope: {message}

not_found.message: Not found on the Vigiora server: {message}

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Vigiora server with entry id {entry_id}.

entry_required.message: Several Vigiora servers are configured: give config_entry_id or a camera.

not_a_camera.message: {entity_id} is not a Vigiora camera entity.

no_room_for_speaker.message: No room was found for this camera or speaker. Vigiora speaks through rooms: give room_id, or add the camera or speaker to a room.

preset_not_found.message: PTZ preset {preset} was not found on the camera.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Says a text aloud through a speaker of a Vigiora room.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Speak in the room this camera belongs to.

output_id.name: Speaker id
output_id.description: A Vigiora speaker (output) id; default the room's default speaker.

room_id.name: Room id
room_id.description: The Vigiora room to speak in.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: The Vigiora server, when several are configured.

ptz_goto_preset.name: Go to PTZ preset
ptz_goto_preset.description: Moves a PTZ camera to a stored preset.

ptz_move.name: Move PTZ
ptz_move.description: Moves a PTZ camera at the given speeds for a short time, then stops.

duration_ms.name: Duration
duration_ms.description: How long to move (at most 5000 ms).

describe_camera.name: Describe camera
describe_camera.description: Runs a Guardian analysis of the camera now and returns the AI's description (uses AI credits).

include_objects.name: Include objects
include_objects.description: Run object recognition first and return the objects found.

prompts.name: Prompts
prompts.description: What object recognition looks for (with include objects).

detect_objects.name: Detect objects
detect_objects.description: Runs open-vocabulary object recognition on the live frame and returns the objects found.

prompts.name: Prompts
prompts.description: What to look for, in plain words (default the camera's list).

acknowledge_alert.name: Acknowledge alert
acknowledge_alert.description: Marks a Vigiora alert as acknowledged.

alert_id.name: Alert id
alert_id.description: The alert's id (the alert_id attribute of the event).

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: The Vigiora server, when several are configured.
